title: Parliament: Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha
quote: Art. 79: Parliament = President + Rajya Sabha + Lok Sabha; no bill becomes law without his assent

boxes.title: Lok Sabha vs Rajya Sabha
head: Basis
Lok Sabha (Art. 81)
Rajya Sabha (Art. 80)
rows: Permanent (**83(1)**); member **6** yrs (**RPA 1951**); **1/3** retire every **2** yrs

boxes.title: Composition notes
items: ⚠ other notes: LS max **552** (incl. **2** Anglo-Indians, **Art. 331**)
Anglo-Indian nomination ended: ==**104th Amdt, 2019**== (from **25 Jan 2020**)
RS nominees: literature, science, art, social service (⚠ sport not listed); first woman **Nargis Dutt** (**1980**)
Only **Delhi, Puducherry, J&K** UTs in RS
First LS: **489** elected; **18** Lok Sabhas so far
LS term extended in Emergency **1 year** at a time (**5th** LS, **1971-77**)

boxes.title: Disqualification & vacation
items: **Art. 102** grounds → ==**President** decides on **EC opinion**== (**Art. 103**)
Defection (**Tenth Schedule**) → **Speaker / Chairman**; **Kihoto Hollohan (1992)**: reviewable
Elected to both Houses: choose in **10 days**, else RS seat vacant
Parliament + State seat: resign State seat in **14 days**
Absence **60 days** without permission (**Art. 101(4)**)
**Kuldip Nayar (2006)**: RS domicile removal (**2003**), open ballot upheld

boxes.title: Constituency extremes
items: Largest: ==**Ladakh**== (**173,266** sq km), then **Barmer**, **Kachchh**
Smallest: **Chandni Chowk** (**10.59** sq km)
Most electors: **Malkajgiri**; fewest: **Lakshadweep**
**84th Amdt (2001)**: seats frozen on **1971** census till after **2026**

boxes.title: Rajya Sabha: equal vs weaker
head: Equal with LS
LS superior
rows: **Money Bill** only in LS; RS returns in **14 days**
No vote on demands; no no-confidence

cards.title: Art. 249
lines: State List law in national interest

cards.title: Art. 67(b)
lines: ==Removal of VP starts only in RS==

cards.title: LS dissolved
lines: RS keeps emergency alive; new LS approves in **30 days**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: AP RS seats = ==**11**== (APPSC 2023); undivided **18** = AP **11** + Telangana **7**
"House as a whole has no privileges" = **wrong** (APPSC-G2 2017); **Sita Soren (2024)**: no privilege for bribe
RS authorises **Parliament**, not State Assemblies (APPSC-G1 2017)
Equal status: CAG report + emergency approval (APPSC G1 2024)
